rust_summary: keyboard key down, up and repeat with modifiers, and gamepad buttons and axes, in values a WebAssembly mod can read (`native_input_key_v2`, `native_input_pad_button`, `native_input_pad_axes`), leaving `native_input_key` compatible.
doc_summary: `native_input_key_v2(key, text, pressed, repeat, modifiers)`: every real window key event after handling, down, up and repeat, with `key` the vanilla name of the physical key (`key.keyboard.z`, empty for a key without one), `text` what it typed and `modifiers` GLFW's bits (shift 1, control 2, alt 4, super 8). `native_input_pad_button(button, pressed)`: a controller button (`south`, `lb`, `dpad_up`...) going down or up, triggers counted as buttons past their threshold. `native_input_pad_axes(left_x, left_y, right_x, right_y, left_trigger, right_trigger)`: the sticks (right and up positive) and triggers (0 to 1) of the merged controller state, when one moved. None can be cancelled. Additive, like `menu_button_v2`: `native_input_key` keeps its signature. Bundles need hooks version @API:input_v2@.
